## MANOJ PATIL

Surat, Gujarat | 6354313728 | mp36117841@gmail.com GitHub: https://github.com/mp3617841-alt

## Professional Summary

BCA final-year student with 6 months of hands-on experience in Core PHP and MySQL development. Skilled in building responsive web applications, REST APIs, and database-driven systems. Seeking an entry-level software developer role to apply technical skills and gain industry experience.

## Education

Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA) Udhna Academy College of Computer Application & IT, Surat Veer Narmad South Gujarat University Expected: 2026

## Technical Skills

Languages: JavaScript, PHP, Java Frontend: HTML, CSS, React.js Backend: Node.js, Express.js Database: MongoDB, MySQL Tools & Concepts: Git, REST APIs, MVC Architecture, Authentication

## Experience

PHP Developer Intern (Self Project) | Jan 2025 - Jun 2025 Developed dynamic web applications using Core PHP and MySQL Built and managed CRUD operations for admin panels and dashboards Worked on form handling, session management, and user authentication Integrated database operations with secure query handling

## Projects E-Commerce Website (MERN Stack)

Developed a full-stack e-commerce web application using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and Node.js Implemented user authentication and authorization system Built shopping cart and order management features Hospital Management System (PHP & MySQL)

Developed a web-based system to manage patient records and appointments Implemented CRUD operations with secure database handling

## Certification

Full Stack Development - KOL Infotech

## Strengths

Quick Learner | Problem-Solving Skills | Team Collaboration | Communication Skills
